subject: South Reservoir Dam Improvements
overview: The Medford Conservation Commission reviewed a Notice of Intent submitted by the Town of Winchester for safety improvements and repairs to the South Reservoir Dam. Following extensive discussion regarding wetland impacts, flood storage, tree removal, and required state permits, the hearing was continued to November 1, 2023.

items.title: South Reservoir Dam Improvement Project Notice of Intent
items.summary: The Commission heard a presentation on proposed dam safety improvements affecting bordering vegetated wetlands, flood storage, and riverfront areas, ultimately voting to continue the hearing to November 1 while state and federal agency reviews proceed.
